grammar.summary: 本课学习年龄与婚姻状态描述，及 can't be 的否定推测。

points.title: can't be 否定推测
points.explanation: 与 must be 相对：She can't be more than thirty.（她不可能超过30岁）。有把握的否定推测一律用 can't be，不用 mustn't。

examples.en: She must be at least forty!

points.title: let's 的否定式
points.explanation: Let's not + 动词原形 = 咱们别……：Let's not talk about it.
